prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1234; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you were involved in in Baytown, Texas. Can you state your full name for the record?

A: Yes, I'm the passenger who was in the vehicle that was hit. I'd rather not give my full name on tape, but I'm happy to answer everything else.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were seated and what you were doing right before the impact?

A: I was in the front passenger seat. We had just pulled into a parking space at the grocery store and I was reaching for my bag in the back seat when we felt the jolt.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the collision?

A: No, I didn't. I was looking down and turned around when I heard the horn. Then the impact hit.

Q: How did your body move during the impact?

A: My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. I hit my forehead on the dashboard, I think, because there was a bump right away.

Q: Did you lose consciousness or feel dazed afterward?

A: I didn't pass out, but I felt foggy and kind of disoriented for the first few minutes. The lights in the lot seemed too bright.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes. I went to the emergency room that evening. They said I had a concussion and told me to rest in a dark room for several days.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. I get headaches most afternoons, I'm sensitive to screens, and I've had trouble concentrating at work. My doctor has me on a reduced schedule for now.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want my medical bills and lost time from work to be covered. I'm still recovering, and I'd appreciate a call when there's an update.
